intent: Make Esteban Moreno Media's existing normal-motion homepage hero video start through native muted inline autoplay while preserving the poster fallback, readable actions, and reduced-motion still state.

visual_evidence.scope_reason: The owner reported that the published hero did not automatically begin playback.
visual_evidence.correction_excerpt: Accesibilidad, movimiento reducido, teclado y rendimiento son condiciones de implementación; no fueron una autorización para eliminar el carácter visual de la versión normal.
visual_evidence.comparison: Existing script-gated playback versus native muted inline autoplay in the same hero composition.

brief.visitor: A phone-first South Florida business, agent, or creator arriving on Esteban Moreno Media.
brief.promise: See Esteban's on-location work immediately and choose a package or start a WhatsApp conversation.
brief.primary_action: Choose a package; WhatsApp remains the direct alternative.
brief.friction: Script-only playback can leave the hero on its still image before motion initialization completes.

kpi.event: existing hero package or WhatsApp action
kpi.baseline: UNKNOWN: no comparable source-tagged inquiry export in this session
kpi.evidence: Live browser inspection showed the source omits HTML autoplay and starts video through CinemaHeroMotion.
kpi.decision_rule: Keep only if visual, playback, and action checks pass; business effect remains unmeasured until a comparable production read.

concept.idea: Use the browser's standard muted inline autoplay path for the existing camera-viewfinder opening.
concept.brand_reason: The existing production footage remains the focal proof; no new visual system is introduced.
concept.interaction: Video begins in normal-motion sessions, loops, and preserves package and WhatsApp actions.
concept.visible_response: The still poster remains visible until frames render; video fades in once playing.
concept.direct_path: Existing package anchor and WhatsApp link.
concept.alternatives: Do not override a visitor's reduced-motion preference or change the hero's copy or layout.

story.opening: Existing on-location footage begins without a tap in normal-motion browsers.
story.action: Visitor chooses a package or opens WhatsApp.
story.next_step: Review packages or describe a project.

content.visible: Existing title, service line, price line, and actions.

references.borrow: Existing Esteban hero, poster fallback, and readable overlay.
references.avoid: Forcing motion for reduced-motion visitors or making text/actions dependent on playback.

components.reuse: Existing HeroVideo, CinemaHeroMotion, Next Image fallback, and hero styles.
components.local_reason: A one-attribute repair in brand-local hero markup.

verification.motion: Native normal-motion autoplay, looping, and reduced-motion poster fallback.
verification.accessibility_performance: Video stays decorative; poster retains meaningful alt text.
verification.raw_html: Initial HTML contains title, actions, and autoplay video markup.
verification.conversion_boundary: Existing package and WhatsApp links remain present; no message is sent.

learning.baseline_source: UNKNOWN: no dated same-page source-tagged inquiry export is available in this session
learning.baseline_value: UNKNOWN: no dated same-page source-tagged inquiry export is available in this session
learning.target: homepage hero action to qualified project inquiry
learning.hypothesis: Reliable immediate motion improves immediate recognition without reducing access to the existing decision paths.
learning.decision_rule: retain only if playback and visual checks pass and attributable inquiry data is measurable
learning.registration_condition: record comparable production event availability before outcome grading
